blocks.text:
After breakfast, leave early for Monteverde, in the cloud forest.

The first part of the day is a tour of the Viento Fresco waterfalls. There are five waterfalls in the Cerro Pelado and Cerro San José area.

After a walk of about one hour along trails overlooking the Gulf of Nicoya, you can swim in the clear water.

A horseback ride back to the start of the trail is offered.

After the walk, enjoy a traditional Costa Rican lunch, then continue to Monteverde.

**Overnight:** El Establo.  
**Meals:** breakfast, lunch.
